svg.title: Figure 7-1 · Assumptions of use by subject and status
svg.desc: Cards for the 15 assumptions of use of WP-C-01 §7, grouped as Vehicle ECUs: AOU-01, AOU-02, AOU-03, AOU-04, AOU-05, AOU-10, AOU-12; Installation and maintenance: AOU-08, AOU-09, AOU-13; Driver: AOU-06, AOU-07; Network and back end: AOU-11; Build configuration: AOU-14, AOU-15. Each card shows the ID, the first clause of the assumption, a status pill (AOU-01 Unverified; AOU-02 Unverified; AOU-03 Unverified; AOU-04 Unverified; AOU-05 Unverified; AOU-06 SOTIF-managed; AOU-07 Not started; AOU-08 Partially; AOU-09 Not started; AOU-10 Not started; AOU-11 Design constraint; AOU-12 Unverified; AOU-13 Unverified; AOU-14 Unverified; AOU-15 Unverified), where it is credited and the verification approach. None is verified.
svg.text: Figure 7-1 · Assumptions of use by subject and status
The 15 assumptions of §7 grouped by what they assume. No assumption is verified; each needs evidence before it is credited.
The Toyota EPS limits the torque applied for
LKA requests to a level a normal driver can
Credited in: HARA controllability of H-01/H-05
max LKA torque at the wheel, timeout behaviour,
A normal driver can override full LKA torque
with steering force within the controllability
criterion set by CA-01 in WP-C-08 §7
Credited in: HARA C-rating H-01, H-05
Verification: Vehicle measurement with a steering
Driver brake pedal application always produces
braking regardless of ACC commands, and the PCM
The stock PCS/AEB keeps full function with the
Verification: Review of forwarded and blocked
The PCM bounds ACC acceleration and
deceleration requests to its own ACC envelope
The cluster cruise indicator is driven by PCM
state and is not influenced by item TX messages
Credited in: FSC FSR-05.05; independent cue for

no active DTCs in the EPS, brake or powertrain
The de-energised harness relay connects the
forward camera to the vehicle CAN without any
Credited in: FSC FSR-07.03; SG-07 safe state
The driver is licensed, attentive, briefed
according to WP-O-03, and keeps their eyes on

The comma.ai back end and network are untrusted
The reference build is used with openpilot's
The reference build is used only on camera-ACC
SOTIF-managed / Design constraint (not a verification status)
Verification line in teal: the approach of §7, not a result.
What credits each assumption (hazardous events, goals, TSRs, HWSRs) is shown in WP-T-01 Figure 6 (assumption exposure); this figure groups the §7 table and does not repeat those counts.
